name: Node Swarm
text: Every node produces 2 adversary ambassadors on its hex.

name: Infiltration Drive
text: In each country, the city that is not corrupted (clean or aligned) with the most adversary ambassadors becomes corrupted.

name: Rapid Buildout
text: The adversary builds now, then spreads.

name: Purge the Unaligned
text: Every player sacrifices an ambassador or a presence; in each country, an adversary troop lands on a factory (with none, a city).

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Ongoing: every round, an extra adversary ambassador at every clean city.

name: Propaganda Network
text: Ongoing: every round, sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Total Offensive
text: The adversary builds and spreads now; sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Armoured Columns
text: In each country, 2 adversary troops land on factories (with none, cities).

name: Station Coup
text: In each country, a research station that is not corrupted becomes corrupted; every node produces an adversary ambassador on its hex.
